body:
# 🎮 PURE — Next-Gen Vanilla Minecraft Client

**PURE** is a premium, vanilla-focused Minecraft client designed to **enhance the core experience** without adding any new content.  
It keeps gameplay **100% vanilla**, while upgrading everything around it: **performance, visuals, audio, and immersion**.

---

## ✨ Why PURE?

With PURE, your Minecraft world feels **faster, smoother, and more alive than ever**:

- 🚀 **Extreme performance** with Sodium, Lithium, Voxy, and advanced culling  
- 🌍 **Next-gen render distance** with Voxy + server-side support on compatible servers  
- 🎨 **Modern visuals** with Iris shaders and connected textures  
- 🔊 **Immersive audio** with Sound Physics Perfected and enhanced environmental sounds  
- 🛠️ **Clean UI & QoL improvements**: BetterF3, Jade, hotbar upgrades, tooltips, and more  
- ⚡ **Smart optimizations**: Dynamic FPS, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast

---

## 🌐 Multiplayer Ready
PURE is fully compatible with vanilla servers — and goes even further:

- 🛰️ Supports **Voxy Server-Side**  
  → Unlock **massive render distance** on supported servers  
  → See landscapes far beyond vanilla limits  

---

## 💡 Performance Tip
If your game feels slow:

- 🔊 Reduce **Sound Physics Perfected** ray launch count  
  → from **200 → 100** for better performance  

---

## 🏆 Philosophy
PURE is built for players who want:

> **A clean, immersive, and optimized Minecraft experience — without changing the game itself.**

No new items. No new mechanics.  
Just **Minecraft, perfected.** ✨
